newsitem.title: USA: Interline Resources delisted from AMEX.
newsitem.headline: Interline Resources delisted from AMEX.

text.p: Interline Resources Corp said Wednesday that the American Stock Exchange has made a final determination to delist its shares.
The company said it would not appeal the ruling, but will immediately seek to have a market developed for its shares in the over-the-counter market.

Interline said the exchange halted trading in its shares July 31, after two companies in litigation with it filed a petition -- which it is seeking to dismiss -- for the company's involuntary bankruptcy.
